probes.question: Which blockchain startup did the Austin, Texas retailers' consortium partner with to deploy its transparent supply chain solution?
verbatim: led by pioneer Kaitlyn Zhou, partnered with blockchain startup ClearChainTech to deploy a transparent supply chain solution

probes.question: On what date did retail analyst Emily Nguyen give the interview in which she said consumers want to feel connected to what they buy?
verbatim: "Consumers want to feel connected to what they buy," Nguyen said in an interview on November 15, 2023.

probes.question: Why could retailers negotiate better deals with suppliers?
probes.answer: Because their operations were transparent, which made suppliers willing to deal with them.
verbatim: With transparent operations, retailers could negotiate better deals with suppliers, who were also keen to be part of this transformative movement.

probes.question: How was a batch of counterfeit goods handled in the law enforcement case described in the document?
probes.answer: It was quickly identified and traced back to its source, thanks to the blockchain ledger.
verbatim: In one case, a batch of counterfeit goods was quickly identified and traced back to its source, thanks to the blockchain ledger.

probes.question: By what year do experts predict blockchain will be a common feature in local retail environments?
verbatim: Experts predict that by 2025, blockchain will be a common feature in local retail environments
